documents.title: Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS and build plate compatibility

notes: The only TDS the page links is the PLA Silk Dual Color sheet (headed "PLA Silk"; Basic Info describes the Dual-Color line). The page links it as the product's "Filament TDS" for every colour, so its values are scoped to the product; the three Gradient colours (Aurora Purple, South Beach, Dawn Radiance) have no separate TDS among the documents.

Mechanical values are printed-specimen results in X-Y (TDS p.3 Specimen Test: 230 °C nozzle, 35 °C bed, 200 mm/s, 100% infill, annealed and dried 55 °C 8 h). The registry has no printed/material split and no Z-direction keys; Z values are kept in each row's note.

TDS values with no registry key: Melt Index 20.5 ± 1.2 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg); Crystallization Temperature N/A; Saturated Water Absorption Rate 0.52% (25 °C, 55% RH); Young's Modulus 1830 ± 210 MPa (X-Y) / 1250 ± 140 MPa (Z); Printing and Storage Humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant); Nozzle Size 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm; Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm; Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s; Chamber Temperature 25 - 45 °C; Max Overhang Angle 55 °; Max Bridging Length ~ 30 mm; Support Material Support for PLA; Bed Surface Preparation Glue; Spool Material ABS (Temperature resistance 70 °C); Spool Size Diameter 200 mm, Height 67 mm; suggested annealing 50 to 55 °C for 6 to 12 h.

TDS p.1 lists Nozzle Size 0.2-0.8 mm while the store page FAQ says the product is not compatible with hardened steel 0.6 / 0.8 mm nozzles; both kept as stated (the nozzle-size row is not a hardened-steel statement).
The store page FAQ says use with A-series printers is not recommended (risk of filament rotation for PLA Silk Dual Color). No relation kind expresses "not recommended"; not recorded as a relation.

The hex table prints two codes for each Dual Color value and 2-4 for each Gradient value, so each entry carries "hexes" in the printed order (Mystic Magenta and Gilded Rose list their codes in the reverse order of their parenthesised colour names).
safety.certifications is neither stored nor listed as not_published: the page's RoHS document (cdn.shopify.com/.../Bambu_PLA_Silk_RoHS.pdf) is not in the offline cache and was not read.
